Product initiative

DOptimiser

AI File & Document Intelligence

An initiative developing AI-assisted file understanding, content-aware classification, semantic discovery and intelligent recommendations.

Register InterestDiscuss a Pilot

In Development

Planned capabilities are under development. Availability, suitability and pilot scope will depend on development progress and agreed requirements.

The business problem

Disorganised enterprise file repositories make content difficult to discover. Inconsistent document classification and manual file analysis add effort and obscure useful information.

What we’re exploring

Content-aware classification

Planned: use file content to suggest meaningful categories for human review.

Semantic discovery

Planned: help people discover relevant files by meaning and context, with appropriate access boundaries.

Intelligent recommendations

Planned: suggest ways to organise and understand files while leaving consequential decisions with users.
